title: Book direct
intro: Choose your dates and who's coming, then continue to the family's secure booking page to see live prices and rooms. No booking fees, and 20% off every scheduled cruise.

stay.property: Where would you like to stay?
stay.split: For {count} guests we'll search for {rooms} rooms.
stay.pickDates: Choose your check-in and check-out dates first.
stay.pickCheckOut: Now choose your check-out date, at least {count} nights after check-in.

chosen.label: You chose
chosen.next: On the next page, look for {names} in the list of available rooms.

terms: Secure card payment through Alpha Bank: a 20% deposit secures your booking and the balance is paid on arrival. Minimum stay 5 nights.
handoff: The next page is the family's own booking system on cptvangelis-apartments.com, with live prices and availability.

payment.title: Secure payment
payment.secure: Encrypted payment. We never see your card details.
